claims.claim: The pipeline generated 29,908 non-overlapping 3-second windows from AcTBeCalf and persisted 6,524 held-out predictions through the existing Store adapter.
claims.evidence: Full offline replay evaluation, feature artifact, and SQLite close/reopen round-trip.
claims.allowed_wording: Pipeline exercised against the recorded AcTBeCalf source export.
claims.limitations: Local offline run; no field/device or multiprocess validation.

claims.claim: Evaluation used 30 calves with 18/6/6 animal-disjoint train/validation/test partitions.
claims.evidence: Split manifest and leakage audit; all animal partition intersections empty.
claims.allowed_wording: Animal-disjoint evaluation on public measured AcTBeCalf data.

claims.claim: The selected Logistic Regression model modestly exceeded majority baseline on held-out accuracy and substantially on macro metrics, but performance remained weak.
claims.evidence: Holdout accuracy 0.533568 vs 0.527897; balanced accuracy 0.199107 vs 0.058824; macro-F1 0.188542 vs 0.040648.
claims.allowed_wording: Research baseline improved over the majority classifier on this split, with weak absolute class-balanced performance.
claims.forbidden_wording: Production-ready behavior recognition or validated accuracy.
claims.limitations: Seven of 17 test classes have F1=0; class imbalance and animal variability are substantial.

claims.claim: The score emitted by the classifier is not calibrated confidence.
claims.evidence: Prediction records preserve uncalibrated model_score and null confidence.

claims.claim: AcTBeCalf axis units, timezone and session identifiers are not available in the audited export.
claims.evidence: Dataset audit: units/timezone unknown, sessions not provided; segId used only as annotation segment.
claims.forbidden_wording: Acceleration in g; UTC timestamp; session-level split.

claims.evidence: Zenodo Rights/License field was empty during verification.
claims.allowed_wording: License status unverified; rights field empty.
claims.forbidden_wording: CC BY or any other specific license assertion.
claims.limitations: Publisher clarification may be needed for redistribution.

claims.evidence: No; daily coverage and biological validation absent.
claims.forbidden_wording: Validated biomarker, diagnostic signature, physiological marker.
claims.limitations: Sparse annotation clips cannot establish daily profiles or physiological validity.

claims.claim: Health anomaly detects or diagnoses disease.
claims.evidence: No clinical outcomes or health metrics in evaluation dataset.
claims.limitations: Requires suitable clinical labels and veterinary validation.

claims.claim: Movement predicts pregnancy, estrus or fertility.
claims.forbidden_wording: Pregnancy detection, estrus diagnosis, fertility prediction.
claims.limitations: Requires appropriate reproductive labels and independent validation.

claims.claim: This public dataset establishes RIOSE field validation.
claims.evidence: Dataset is external AcTBeCalf public measured data; no RIOSE field data used.
claims.forbidden_wording: RIOSE measured lab or field validated.
